name: Rendered-Page Acceptance Policy
core_requirements: Markdown and target records remain content source of truth.
Rendered PDF/HTML pages are acceptance proof for student-facing readability, layout, visual quality, and print/product quality.
Student-facing textbook changes require full-page rendered proof, page PNGs or contact sheets, pages inspected, and defect disposition.
Visible student-facing defects are blockers, not PASS WITH FLAGS carry items.
Proof artifact convention exists for future PDF page renders and contact sheets.
Textbook workflow and lead-review instructions cite the rendered-page acceptance standard.
No lesson content, generated lesson output, protected machine/external reference data, or product gates are changed.
scope: Add a durable platform-owned rendered-page acceptance standard.
Wire the standard into textbook sprint/review expectations.
Record sprint evidence under reports/sprints and references/data/sprints.
forbidden: No edits under references/machine or references/external.
No textbook paragraph, chapter, or book content edits.
No validator that claims to judge subjective visual quality automatically.

No diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery, sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, Scale Gate 1, product-route adoption, or student/product-use authorization.
